description: NewgenONE is a unified enterprise platform that integrates content, process, communication, data science, and AI agents into a single low-code ecosystem. It enables organizations to move beyond traditional automation and adopt decision intelligence, where AI actively participates in business decisions. The platform orchestrates workflows across systems, people, and data, embedding AI into every layer to create intelligent, adaptive, and autonomous enterprise operations.
key_capabilities: Unified orchestration of content, process, communication, and AI
summary: Central platform that powers all Newgen products and enables intelligent enterprise automation.

description: OmniDocs is a contextual content services platform that manages the entire lifecycle of enterprise content, from capture and storage to archival and compliance. It transforms static documents into intelligent knowledge assets by integrating AI for classification, search, and summarization. The platform connects content directly with business processes, enabling faster decision-making and improved operational efficiency.
summary: Central repository for managing enterprise content with AI-driven intelligence.

description: iBPS is the core process automation engine of NewgenONE that enables organizations to design, automate, and optimize business workflows. It combines low-code development with AI-driven decision-making, allowing enterprises to build applications rapidly and adapt processes dynamically. The platform integrates human tasks, RPA bots, and AI systems into a unified workflow orchestration engine.
summary: Engine for designing and automating enterprise workflows with AI-driven intelligence.

description: OmniOMS is a comprehensive customer communication platform that enables organizations to design, generate, and deliver personalized communications across multiple channels. It uses AI to optimize messaging, personalize content, and analyze customer interactions, ensuring consistent and engaging communication experiences.
summary: Platform for managing and personalizing customer communications across channels.

description: IDP Studio is an AI-powered document processing solution that extracts structured data from unstructured documents such as invoices, forms, and contracts. It uses machine learning and OCR technologies to automate document classification, data extraction, and validation.
summary: AI solution for extracting and structuring data from documents.

description: This platform enables enterprises to build, deploy, and manage machine learning models and analytics solutions. It supports the entire AI lifecycle, from data preparation to model deployment, and integrates seamlessly with business processes for real-time decision-making.
summary: Platform for building and deploying AI and analytics solutions.

description: Marvin is a generative AI-powered assistant embedded within NewgenONE that enhances productivity by automating workflows, summarizing documents, and enabling natural language interactions. It assists both developers and business users by generating applications and insights.
summary: AI assistant that enhances productivity and automates tasks.

description: Harper is an AI agent focused on improving customer engagement and conversion rates. It analyzes customer interactions, identifies patterns, and provides actionable insights to optimize sales and service outcomes.
summary: AI agent for improving customer engagement and conversion.

description: LumYn is an AI agent designed to identify growth opportunities and predict customer behavior. It uses advanced analytics and AI models to support marketing and business growth strategies.
summary: AI agent for identifying growth opportunities and predicting trends.

description: Agent Studio is a low-code development environment within NewgenONE that enables enterprises to design, train, and deploy custom AI agents. It allows integration with workflows, data sources, and APIs, enabling organizations to build domain-specific intelligent agents that automate decision-making and business processes.
summary: Platform for building and deploying custom AI agents within NewgenONE.
